verdict.rationale: Decagon's own integrations page says the agent can retrieve data, take action and handle escalations across chat, email and voice with no custom code. Its standalone chat, email and voice channels cover the standalone half of the story. However, nothing in the evidence names Zendesk, Salesforce or Intercom, describes running inside those helpdesks, or documents two-way ticket sync. Missing for 10: named helpdesk integrations (Zendesk/Salesforce/Intercom), embedded in-helpdesk deployment, documented bidirectional ticket and context sync, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the agent runs inside my existing helpdesk — Zendesk, Salesforce, Intercom — or standalone, syncing tickets and context both ways

citations.quote: They ensure your agent can retrieve data, take action, and handle escalations smoothly across chat, email, and voice channels with no custom code required.
Maintain customer context across sessions, complementing your systems of record with data portability and control.
Flexible, on-brand chat built for conversations across web, mobile, and messaging platforms.
